comments.author: @Johnnybananass-_
comments.text: Japan's railways also work so well because the Japanese people respect the trains, the stations and the staff. No one throws rubbish at stations or on the trains, or jumps the turnstiles; they board in an orderly way and respect the service. In the West, we would have graffiti on the trains, stations that looked like toilets and service abused by people jumping the turnstiles. These are the same reasons all trains work, and taxis and cities are lovely and clean. I just spent a month in Japan in 7 cities, and you come back ashamed of how we treat what we have in the Western world.  We are entitled and let people destroy things for fun, with a slap on the wrist.

Grafitti was only really a problem in the 1970s, nowadays it's nonexistent.
We don't spend money on routine station maintenance, that's why our stations look so bad.
Platform screen doors would help make sure that trash doesn't get onto the tracks and cause wheel slip.  And it would stop old Grandpa from falling onto the tracjs and getting electrocuted by the 3rd rail.
I don't care one hoot about fare evasion.  Metros, buses, and trams should be fare-free.  Now, people who don't pay for car parking, on the other hand...
